premise: Flower wishes she could fly like Butterfly and Bird; they describe the sky to her from up high; at summer's end the wind lifts her seeds, and a piece of her flies after all.
inspiration: Andersen's The Daisy, turned happy: the flower is not left behind; her friends bring the sky down and her seeds carry her up.
lesson: You can reach far places without leaving where you are.
learning: The wind carries a flower's seeds away, and new flowers grow where they land.

en-US.title: Flower Wants to Fly
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} {bird:float loop 0.3} Flower {flower:pulse} had roots. Very good for standing. No good for flying. [sad] I wish I could fly, she said, as Butterfly {butterfly:wobble} looped the loop. What is it like up there? [curious] Up there, said Butterfly, the meadow looks like a green blanket. Up there, said Bird, {bird:hop} the river is a silver ribbon. Bee {bee:wobble} hummed past. Flower listened all summer long. Summer ended. Her petals went soft and fell. Where they had been grew a round white puff. [gasps] Flower, said Bird. A breeze came. {sfx:wind} Whoosh… {flower:shake 0.4} and the puff came apart into a hundred tiny seeds with tiny parachutes. {flower:sparkle} {sfx:seeds solo} Up they went. Over the meadow. Over the silver river. [happily] Flower did not have wings. But next spring, across the river, there was a new flower, and it looked exactly like her.

es-ES.title: Flor quiere volar
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} {bird:float loop 0.3} Flor {flower:pulse} tenía raíces. Muy buenas para estar de pie. Malísimas para volar. [sad] Ojalá pudiera volar, dijo, mientras Mariposa {butterfly:wobble} hacía el rizo. ¿Cómo es allí arriba? [curious] Allí arriba, dijo Mariposa, el prado parece una manta verde. Allí arriba, dijo Pájaro, {bird:hop} el río es una cinta de plata. Abeja {bee:wobble} pasó zumbando. Flor escuchó todo el verano. El verano se acabó. Sus pétalos se ablandaron y cayeron. Y donde estaban creció una bola blanca y redonda, de pelusa. [gasps] Flor, dijo Pájaro. Vino una brisa. {sfx:wind} Fiuuu… {flower:shake 0.4} y la bola se deshizo en cien semillitas con cien paracaídas diminutos. {flower:sparkle} {sfx:seeds solo} Arriba. Por encima del prado. Por encima del río de plata. [happily] Flor no tenía alas. Pero a la primavera siguiente, al otro lado del río, había una flor nueva, y era igualita que ella.

wind.prompt: a soft breeze rising across a meadow, gentle whoosh

seeds.prompt: a dandelion puff coming apart, dozens of tiny fluffy seeds whispering away on the air, airy and delicate
